BiblicalUsage: Piq is a tottering, knees knocking together. It stands once, in Nahum 2:10, in the sack of Nineveh: she is empty, and void, and waste; and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the knees of the proud will knock one day, and no army can hold them steady.
